items.difficulty_reason: The lemma embeds any differential graded module into a product of shifts of A-dual injectively and injectively on the cokernels of the differentials (statement lines 2654-2665). The proof (lines 2667-2705) is a genuine dual-pairing construction: the free-module surjection dualized twice, the admissible two-term structure of each summand dualized to an extension of shifted duals, and a functional-separation argument through the Hom-into-shift-dual lemma for the cokernel condition. H2: the duality bookkeeping and the separation step carry the argument; one ingredient (the free surjection) is the parallel construction from the proof of the sibling lemma lemma-good-quotient, cited in place, and the dependency is recorded on the card.
